info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_QR Payment Requests Management API
info.description: The QR Payment Requests Management API allows users to efficiently manage and update QR payment requests. This endpoint facilitates modifications to existing payment requests identified by a unique parameter. Typical consumers include financial institutions and payment service providers looking to streamline payment processing. By enabling adjustments to details such as amounts or expiration times, this API enhances transaction flexibility and user experience.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update an existing QR payment request identified by its unique ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to modify the payment request accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate or update a QR payment request for the transaction identified by PAY-300045. Ensure that all required fields specified in the schema are included.
